title: List of races — HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB
claims: The races page lists the 100M on 9 October 2026 from Rim Nordic Ski Area, and the 100K, 50K, 21K and 10K on 10 October 2026 from The Village of Big Bear Lake.
The page shows 8 Running Stones for the 100M, 6 for the 100K, 4 for the 50K and 2 for the 21K, with no stone count for the 10K.
The page is still showing the 2026 edition, with 2027 registration described as opening soon rather than a 2027 race list.
